scope: Individual declarations and already effective raw-action projection only. No art, image, generation or approval changes.

actors.name: Marcus Fenix
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), Marcus Fenix in original Delta Squad armor
actors.visualAnchor: Adult Marcus with a dark bandana, short dark hair, scarred square face, heavy grey-blue COG armor and cyan armor lights. His Lancer Mk2 has a firearm barrel and an attached chainsaw bayonet; no old-man beard, Gears 4 farm clothes or E-Day model.
equipment: Lancer Mk2 assault rifle with chainsaw bayonet

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 campaign, Delta Squad; the Hammer of Dawn is an external satellite weapon guided by a designator, never a beam emitted by the rifle.

actors.sourceWeaponFamily: Mk2 Lancer firearm and attached chainsaw bayonet; existing hybrid engine family retained

actors.name: Dom Santiago
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), Dominic Santiago in Delta Squad armor
actors.visualAnchor: Adult Dom with short dark hair, dark facial stubble, exposed muscular arms, grey-blue COG plates and blue lights. Carry Lancer Mk2/Gnasher as physical weapons; no Gears 3 grief-era long beard or supernatural Maria manifestation.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 Delta Squad campaign; Maria is a person and story motivation, not an attacking entity.

actors.name: Augustus Cole
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), Augustus Cole in original Delta Squad armor
actors.visualAnchor: Adult Black, muscular Augustus Cole with close-cropped hair, broad exposed arms, grey-blue COG armor and blue lights. Physical Lancer and Gnasher remain separate from his former Thrashball role; no Thrashball uniform or dialogue turned into projectiles.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 Delta Squad combat model; Cole Train dialogue does not create a new weapon or energy power.

secondary.name: Tir rapproché de Gnasher de Cole

actors.name: Damon Baird
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), young Damon Baird in COG field armor
actors.visualAnchor: Young adult Baird with short blond hair, goggles resting on his forehead, grey-blue COG armor and cyan lamps. He carries a physical Lancer and ordinary maintenance tools; no old-man beard, Fabricator, autonomous turret or later-era robot.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 campaign field mechanic; maintenance/guard remains an explicitly bounded support adaptation, not biological healing or a conjured robot.

actors.name: Anya Stroud
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 3 (2011), Anya Stroud in frontline COG armor
actors.visualAnchor: Adult blonde Anya in practical grey-blue COG combat armor with cyan lamps, dark underlayers and a physical Lancer Mk2. This is her frontline Gears 3 model, not the Gears 1 radio-room uniform or a later memorial image.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 3, Anya as a frontline squad member; retain actual rifle recoil and no invented command-fire magic.

actors.name: Colonel Hoffman
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), Colonel Victor Hoffman during the Jacinto defense
actors.visualAnchor: Older Colonel Victor Hoffman with weathered face, dark COG beret, heavy grey-blue officer armor and cyan armor lamps. A physical service firearm is carried; command orders do not project a holographic shield or summon soldiers.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 Jacinto command/defense scenes. Existing leadership buffs/guards are Nexus abstractions; no specific unseen firearm attachment is inferred.

simple.name: Arme de service du colonel Hoffman

secondary.name: Ordre de défense du commandement COG

special.name: Ordre de mise en défense de Hoffman

actors.name: Carmine
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 3 (2011), specifically adult Clayton Carmine
actors.visualAnchor: Clayton Carmine has a fully closed opaque COG helmet, grey-blue heavy armor, blue lamps and conspicuously muscular bare arms. Carry a Lancer Mk2; do not substitute Anthony, Benjamin, Gary or Lizzie, their helmets, sleeves or eras.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 3 adult Clayton model, selected already by the existing W14 source contract; the historical Carmine ID remains unchanged.

secondary.name: Visée du Lancer Mk2 de Clayton

defense.name: Garde du casque COG de Clayton

special.name: Rafale du Lancer de Clayton Carmine

actors.name: Kait Diaz
actors.incarnation: Gears 5 (2019), adult Kait in the winter COG field outfit
actors.visualAnchor: Adult Kait with dark brown hair, practical grey-blue winter COG armor, a visible fur collar and a physical Lancer Mk3. Preserve the winter field silhouette rather than Gears 4 Outsider clothing, Locust anatomy or a supernatural Swarm attack.
equipment: Winter COG armor with fur collar

sourceScene.description: Gears 5 winter campaign model, consistent with W14. Personal connection to the Swarm is not an offensive mind-control ability.

simple.name: Tir du Lancer Mk3 de Kait

secondary.name: Visée de terrain du Lancer de Kait

actors.name: Locust Drone
actors.incarnation: Gears of War (2006), ordinary Locust Drone infantry
actors.visualAnchor: Pale grey humanoid Locust Drone with a broad heavy head, thick neck, muscular stocky body, dark Locust harness/armor and a carried Hammerburst. No elite Theron cape, Swarm red tissue or Skaarj wrist blades.

sourceScene.description: Original 2006 Locust infantry campaign model; ordinary Drone rather than Grenadier, Theron or Swarm Drone.

actors.name: Locust Wretch
actors.incarnation: Gears of War (2006), non-Lambent Wretch
actors.visualAnchor: Small hunched pale-grey Locust Wretch with long forelimbs, digitigrade hind limbs, clawed hands and a toothy head. It runs and climbs close to the ground; no gun, armor plates, Lambent yellow glow or explosive sac.

sourceScene.description: Original non-Lambent Wretch; distinct from the explosive Lambent Wretches in the Imulsion facility.

actors.name: Explosive Ticker
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), Locust explosive Ticker
actors.visualAnchor: Low-slung squat Ticker with small eyes, tusk-like jaws, short scuttling legs and a visible explosive charge strapped to its back. Preserve the separate bomb harness; no wild unarmed Ticker or human suicide bomber anatomy.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 explosive Ticker, distinct from the wild Ticker later used to consume fortifications.

actors.name: Theron Guard
actors.incarnation: Gears of War (2006), standard Theron Guard
actors.visualAnchor: Tall Locust Theron Guard in ornate red-brown armor, distinctive crested helmet and draped coat/cape, carrying a physical Torque Bow. No unarmored Drone, later armored Kantus or RAAM-sized silhouette.

sourceScene.description: Original Gears of War Torque Bow guard; standard Guard rather than a Theron Sentinel or cross-game elite.

actors.name: Boomer Locust
actors.incarnation: Gears of War (2006), Boomshot-equipped Boomer
actors.visualAnchor: Very large heavyset pale Locust with a small head, thick exposed arms, heavy dark shoulder armor and a two-handed Boomshot grenade launcher. No Grinder minigun, Mauler shield or Berserker anatomy.

sourceScene.description: Original Boomshot Boomer, not another Boomer caste or a generic rocket soldier.

actors.name: Kantus Priest
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), standard Kantus priest
actors.visualAnchor: Tall lean Kantus with long limbs, elongated head, dark reddish ceremonial armor/robes and a physical Gorgon pistol. Keep the narrow priest silhouette distinct from the bulky armored Kantus of Gears 3; no conjured staff or wings.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 standard Kantus. Source revival/coordination does not mean our generic enemy AI implements that full mechanic.

actors.name: Corpser Hatchling
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 3 (2011), juvenile Corpser hatchling
actors.visualAnchor: Small juvenile Corpser with a compact arachnid-like body, recessed head and long jointed digging limbs spreading around it. Keep the juvenile scale and bare creature anatomy; no adult armored head, Brumak guns or dorsal rocket rack.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 3 juvenile Corpsers in the underground nest; not the adult mother or an ordinary armored adult.

actors.name: General RAAM
actors.incarnation: Gears of War (2006) - Lightmass Bomb train
actors.visualAnchor: Huge pale Locust general, dark heavy armor, Troika heavy machine gun and protective Kryll swarm on the moving Lightmass Bomb train. No Skorge chainsaw staff or Brumak vehicle.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2006 Lightmass Bomb train encounter; preserve the existing exact incarnation, Troika, Kryll protection and Lightmass scene binding.

actors.name: High Priest Skorge
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), Skorge at Nexus
actors.visualAnchor: Skorge is a tall narrow Kantus leader with pale grey skin, an elongated head, dark reddish ceremonial armor and a double-ended chainsaw staff. No RAAM Troika, generic wizard staff or Reaver body fused into the character.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 Nexus duel, on foot; his Hydra mount belongs to a separate encounter and must not be merged into the staff model.

actors.name: Berserker Matriarch
actors.incarnation: Gears 5 (2019), the Matriarch at the Mount Kadar laboratory
actors.visualAnchor: The Gears 5 Matriarch is a massive blind, heavily plated female Locust with powerful forelimbs and a vulnerable exposed back. Target her laboratory/ice-arena form; do not reuse an ordinary 2006 Berserker, a Lambent Berserker or invented weapons.
equipment: Natural armored body and charging limbs

sourceScene.description: Gears 5 Act II Mount Kadar laboratory/ice-arena Matriarch boss; historical Berserker Matriarch name is a roster alias, not a license to merge Berserker forms.

actors.name: Karn Locust General
actors.incarnation: Gears of War: Judgment (2013), Karn mounted on Shibboleth
actors.visualAnchor: Karn is a pale armored Locust general positioned on the back of the large arachnid-like Shibboleth. Preserve rider and mount as distinct bodies; do not replace the mount with a Brumak or label Karn a generic sniper.

sourceScene.description: Judgment final Halvo Bay battle with Karn and Shibboleth. The generic actor AI does not claim complete separately controlled rider/mount mechanics.

actors.name: Queen Myrrah
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 3 (2011), Myrrah and the Tempest encounter
actors.visualAnchor: Adult Myrrah is a pale human-looking queen with light hair and elaborate dark-gold Locust regalia. Her physical Tempest mount is a separate enormous winged creature; do not fuse its wings or limbs into Myrrah or borrow Skorge armor.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 3 final Azura Tempest fight; rider and creature remain distinct source entities. A lone queen sprite cannot certify a mounted boss depiction.

actors.name: Corpser Burrower
actors.incarnation: Gears of War (2006), adult Corpser in the Imulsion mine
actors.visualAnchor: Enormous subterranean arachnid-shaped Corpser with a recessed body, broad multi-eyed head and very long raised hooked digging limbs. Its source creature has no gun arms or dorsal missile pack; preserve adult rather than hatchling proportions.

sourceScene.description: Original 2006 underground Imulsion-mine Corpser encounter, distinct from the Gears 3 nest mother and juveniles.

actors.name: Gargantuan Brumak
actors.incarnation: Gears of War 2 (2008), armed Brumak before Lambent mutation
actors.visualAnchor: Huge grey reptilian Brumak with a separate Locust pilot, heavy metal harness, arm-mounted guns and a dorsal missile rack. No tentacles, glowing Imulsion growths or final Lambent Brumak form; Gargantuan is Nexus scaling, not a separate canonical species.

sourceScene.description: Gears of War 2 armed Brumak campaign model before Lambent transformation. Boss scale, phases and target geometry remain existing Nexus adaptations.

actors.name: Isaac Clarke
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), Isaac Clarke and level-3 engineering RIG
actors.visualAnchor: Original 2008 Isaac wears the bronze-brown level-3 engineering RIG with heavy segmented ribs, enclosed helmet, three cyan visor bars and a cyan spinal health strip. Hold the 211-V Plasma Cutter as a separate engineering tool; no remake redesign, Advanced Suit or Arctic suit.

sourceScene.description: Original Dead Space 2008 USG Ishimura campaign. The selected authored actions are Plasma Cutter fire, readiness and personal guard; Stasis/Kinesis are not arbitrary gravity damage.

actors.name: John Carver
actors.incarnation: Dead Space 3 (2013), John Carver in military RIG
actors.visualAnchor: Adult John Carver wears his bulky dark military RIG with red illuminated eye lenses and a blue/cyan spinal health strip. A physical modular military rifle is carried in both hands; no Isaac engineering helmet, Marker body growth or weapon made of hallucinations.

sourceScene.description: Dead Space 3 co-op campaign Carver model. Keep his soldier equipment distinct from Isaac and the hallucination sequences; the authored burst has bounded engine timing.

simple.name: Tir du fusil militaire de Carver

actors.name: Ellie Langford
actors.incarnation: Dead Space 2 (2011), Ellie Langford in civilian pilot workwear
actors.visualAnchor: Adult Ellie has dark hair tied back, pale sleeveless work top, brown utility trousers and practical boots. Use the living civilian pilot model of the Sprawl era; no Dead Space 3 winter coat or Isaac-style engineering RIG. Scene-specific eye state must be checked against the selected shot before art approval.

sourceScene.description: Dead Space 2 Ellie pilot scenes. Her escape route is not an area-damage power; exact pre/post-injury eye state remains a scene-review requirement.

actors.name: Nicole Brennan
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), living human medical officer Nicole Brennan
actors.visualAnchor: Nicole is a living human medical officer in the original 2008 context, with loosely tied auburn/light-brown hair and practical grey-blue medical clothing. An ordinary datapad may support clinical instructions; no ghost glow, Marker lesions, summoned console or healing beam.

sourceScene.description: Original Dead Space 2008 Nicole medical-record context, before her death; not a Marker hallucination or Dead Space 2 spectral version. Guard and clinical support are role adaptations.

defense.name: Refuge dans le poste médical Ishimura

actors.name: Zach Hammond
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), security chief Zach Hammond
actors.visualAnchor: Original 2008 Zach Hammond is an adult Black man with close-cropped hair, dark brown security RIG and blue spinal lights. Carry the SWS Motorized Pulse Rifle; no remake model, Isaac engineering helmet or 211-V Plasma Cutter mislabeled as his rifle.

sourceScene.description: Dead Space 2008 Kellion/Ishimura security chief, alive before the USM Valor encounter in Chapter 9; firearm action, not an escape-pod super.

simple.name: Tir du Pulse Rifle de Hammond

special.name: Rafale du Pulse Rifle de Hammond

actors.name: Kendra Daniels
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), original Kendra Daniels
actors.visualAnchor: Original 2008 Kendra is an adult human woman with a short dark bob, practical grey-blue technical jumpsuit and a small handheld diagnostic pad. No remake face/costume, military RIG, conjured energy weapon or offensive terminal lightning.

sourceScene.description: Original Dead Space 2008 technician scenes. The existing W15 diagnostic/relay actions are zero-damage support adaptations, not source-certified healing or magic.

actors.name: Zach Hammond
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), Zach Hammond; retained historical duplicate actor ID
actors.visualAnchor: This separate historical roster slot depicts the same living 2008 security chief Zach Hammond: adult Black man, close-cropped hair, brown security RIG, blue spinal lamps and physical Pulse Rifle. It is not a new character, ghost, remake model or merged save identity.

sourceScene.description: Historical hammond_ds alias retained separately from zach_hammond. Its old mechanics are preserved and require a dedicated source-action review; they are not silently upgraded to the W15 kit.

actors.sourceActionReview: OPEN: historical duplicate keeps its existing action mechanics; no W15 source kit inferred from a shared character name.

actors.name: Necromorph Slasher Scythe
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), standard human Slasher
actors.visualAnchor: Original human Slasher with an emaciated humanoid torso, elongated bladed forelimbs, residual human legs and ragged civilian/workwear remnants. Scythe denotes its organic arm blades, not a carried medieval scythe or demonic armor.

sourceScene.description: Descriptive historical alias for the original 2008 Slasher, not a new weapon-bearing species.

actors.name: Necromorph Leaper Demon
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), standard Leaper
actors.visualAnchor: Leaper has a low horizontal human-derived body, powerful forearms and a long hooked/barbed tail; its lower limbs are fused into the tail form. Keep the crawling/leaping anatomy without demon horns, wings, human running legs or a carried sword.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Leaper; Demon is a historical encounter label, not evidence of a crossover demon.

actors.name: Necromorph Lurker Pod
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), original Lurker crawler
actors.visualAnchor: Small original Lurker with a compact low crawler body and three independently raised organic tentacles ending in projectile spines. Preserve the three-tentacle silhouette; no adult soldier RIG, quadruped animal model from another installment or mechanical turret.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Lurker, with the historical Pod label treated as an encounter alias rather than a distinct species.

actors.name: Slasher Necromorph
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), standard Slasher
actors.visualAnchor: Human-derived Slasher with a narrow upright torso, extremely long organic arm blades and torn civilian/work clothes, moving on human-derived legs. Do not substitute an armored military variant, a Divider or generic clawed demon.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 standard Slasher; a source model target, not approval of existing generated pixels.

actors.name: Pregnant Necromorph
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), Pregnant form
actors.visualAnchor: Large heavy humanoid Necromorph with a swollen abdomen, thick body and long bladed forearms. The abdomen contains separate Swarmers; no explosive yellow Exploder sac, infant Lurker body or firearm.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Pregnant; release of Swarmers is a source behavior and is not claimed to be fully simulated by the generic enemy AI.

actors.name: Exploder Necromorph
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), Exploder form
actors.visualAnchor: Thin asymmetrical humanoid Exploder with one ordinary clawed arm and one conspicuously large yellow explosive pustule hanging from the other side. Its sac detonates; it is not an acid-spitting organ or a carried grenade launcher.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Exploder; correct the former acid_sac descriptor without adding an unimplemented chemical-damage mechanic.

actors.name: Divider Necromorph
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), Divider form
actors.visualAnchor: Very tall thin humanoid Divider with stretched torso, small head and long spindly limbs that can separate into independently moving components. No bulky Brute armor, gun, or invented magic splitting staff.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Divider; detached-limb simulation remains a distinct gameplay/animation requirement, not implied by metadata.

actors.name: Leaper Necromorph
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), standard Leaper
actors.visualAnchor: Low elongated Leaper with thick supporting forearms and a long bladed tail replacing ordinary lower-body locomotion. Preserve the long tail and forearm-driven leaps; no upright human stride, wings or humanoid weapon.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Leaper; separate historical roster entry retained without merging identities.

actors.name: Infector Winged Corpse
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), Infector form
actors.visualAnchor: Broad low Infector with a flattened torso, two large membranous wing-like limbs and a projecting infection proboscis. It works on corpses; no Slasher scythes, adult humanoid gun stance or Resident Evil T-Virus equipment.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Infector, whose corpse-conversion behavior is not certified by a generic damage attack.

actors.name: Necromorph Infector Pod
actors.sourceIdentityReview: OPEN: canonical Infector base organism does not establish the invented Pod/boss form. Incarnation, visual contract and source scene remain unresolved.
actors.sourceActionReview: Nexus-only boss/Pod variant remains unresolved. Remove the Resident Evil T-Virus label; do not invent a canonical Pod organism, visual model or source-scene approval.
actors.canonStatus: Unresolved Nexus-only encounter alias. No canonical Pod identity or visual source is established; existing combat remains an adaptation.

actors.name: Armored Brute Smasher
actors.incarnation: Dead Space (2008), armored Brute form
actors.visualAnchor: Very large hunched humanoid Brute with broad organic frontal armor, massive forearms and comparatively small rear legs. Preserve its organic plating and vulnerable shoulder/back regions; no metal knight armor, gun turret or Payday Bulldozer identity.

sourceScene.description: Original 2008 Brute. Armored Brute Smasher is a descriptive Nexus boss alias and does not certify a named canonical boss variant.
